messages:
jordyn: Observed multiple onboarding sample failures today. Node, Python, and Go all report different shapes for the same auth-failure case. This is causing flaky retry logic in quickstart.
alejandra: Can you share an example payload from each SDK?
jordyn: Short repro snippets: Node prints { error: { code: 'AUTH_EXPIRED', status: 401, message: 'token expired' } }
Python raises RedwoodAuthError('token expired') with no status attr.
Go returns err with Error() == '401 Unauthorized' and no structured fields.
alejandra: Ugh. That's exactly the problem we tried to avoid. We need a small, language-agnostic envelope spec that SDKs map to.
sam: Proposal: canonical fields: code (string), status (int|null), message (human), machine (raw payload), retryable ("yes"|"no"|"unknown"), retry_hint (nullable string), request_id (string|null), envelope_version: "v1". Keep names explicit.
jordyn: Agree. For streaming: error frames must be same envelope as a single-line JSON to avoid ad-hoc parsing.
mike: Implementation plan: 1) runtime returns envelope on errors by default; 2) SDKs map envelope -> typed exceptions with getter helpers; 3) sample-apps updated to assert envelope fields.
alejandra: Add small SDK helper functions: is_retryable(err), get_retry_after(err), get_request_id(err). We should ship those in all SDKs to reduce app plumbing.
sam: Tests: add interop test in sample-apps that returns 401/429 and asserts all SDKs expose envelope fields. CI should fail if any SDK loses attrs.
ops-bot: note: created ticket INF-1293 to track canonical error contract work.
jordyn: Owners: @alejandra spec + sample-app changes, @mike runtime + node sdk, @sam python + go sdk adapters, @jordyn tests. Targets: spec PR by EOD tomorrow, sample app infra test by end of week.
alejandra: I'll draft the minimal spec now and link PRs here. Keep it intentionally tiny so we can iterate.
mike: One more ask: include guidance for backwards compatibility - include legacy_message field when present so older apps don't break immediately.
jordyn: Good call. That will smooth migration.
sam: Thanks team. This will cut onboarding friction and reduce one-off parsing hacks in quickstarts.
